objective: Separate missing live plank state, wrong Euclidean objective, and insufficient affine grammar while compiling the admitted MLP0/1 causal subspaces into a poison-gated executable tensor program.
scope_guardrail: This is a new isolated experiment. It preserves v1 and its erratum, does not update the base model, ship, or v3 bases, and earns no executable or whole-model recovery until a clean last-written v2 authority binds a final result. Full-native K=4608 is an executable adequacy ceiling, not a simplicity claim.

motivation.v1_descriptive_failure: QNN gained 0.010115 nats, NQN lost 0.098182, and QQN lost 0.050548; the dominant failure was MLP1.
motivation.missing_state: v1 predicted B^T(f_original(z)-mo) from z alone even though live deployed mo contains token/context state not mathematically determined by z.
motivation.correct_interface: p_l(z)=f_l_original(z) B_l; c_l(z,mo)=p_l(z)-mo B_l; delta_l=c_l B_l^T.
motivation.wrong_loss_hypothesis: v3 effect retention exceeded basis energy capture in all 12 backgrounds, while v1 MLP1 had higher coefficient R2 but worse causal behavior. Variance/L2 may emphasize behaviorally weak directions.
motivation.wrong_grammar_hypothesis: The original MLP is exactly bilinear, so a native product program represents p_l(z) exactly at K=4608 and may compress at smaller K where affine prediction fails.

pinned_prior.v1_role: Frozen negative/descriptive anchor only; no v1 final row or saved registered boolean is reused for fitting, selection, thresholds, or v2 inference.

fresh_rows.authority: new versioned receipt from the pinned ordered FineWeb first parquet
requirements: All roles have row-aligned document/chunk provenance.
All v2 roles are pairwise document/full-row/prefix-32 disjoint.
All v2 roles are document/full-row/prefix-32 disjoint from every v1 and earlier oracle role.
The row receipt is committed before label capture.
The token-frequency strata are computed from compiler_validation, serialized and hashed before the first compiler_final forward.

native_algebra.type_gate: Fail closed unless each target block.mlp is the ungated bilinear form f(z)=D[(Lz) odot (Rz)]+b with exactly 4608 products. If gated=True, SiLU, or any additional nonlinearity is present, no native-product result is scored.
native_algebra.model: For K_full=4608, f(z)=((z L^T) odot (z R^T)) D^T + b, using PyTorch weight orientation L,R:[K_full,1152], D:[1152,K_full].
native_algebra.projected_decoder: Q=D^T B with shape [K_full,64]; beta=b B.
native_algebra.selected_program: p_S(z)=sum_{i in S} Q_i (L_i z)(R_i z)+beta.
native_algebra.full_identity_gate: At S={0,...,4607}, p_S(z) must match block.mlp(z) B on held-out canary tensors before any selection, and the poison-gated full-native arm must match the live O physical correction and validation row CE within preregistered float tolerances.
native_algebra.product_gauge: Unit-normalize stored L_i and R_i, absorb the positive norm product into Q_i, and fix the reciprocal joint sign by making the largest-absolute L_i entry positive. Support scores and prices must be invariant to L_i->a L_i,R_i->a^-1 R_i and to swapping L_i/R_i. Price both rows and Q_i; checkpoint pointers are forbidden.

causal_objective.fit_context_site0: OON teacher states: projected-oracle MLP0 and MLP1, deployed MLP2-N, so the adjoint measures what a correct downstream MLP1/suffix reads.
causal_objective.fit_context_site1: After validation freezes Q0, regenerate site-1 fit states autoregressively under Q0 and capture adjoints in QON with projected-oracle MLP1 and deployed MLP2-N.
causal_objective.adjoint: For each fit token capture g_t=d CE_suffix/d c_t at the frozen teacher state with one frozen-suffix backward. MLP2-E is forbidden in fitting and remains a held-out intervention background.
causal_objective.loss: For projected-output error e_t=p_hat(z_t)-p(z_t), L_causal=mean((g_t^T e_t)^2)/mean(||g_t||_2^2)+0.05*mean(||e_t||_2^2)/64. The exact -mo B term cancels from e_t.
causal_objective.fit_only_hygiene: Gradient clipping threshold is the compiler_fit 99th percentile of ||g_t|| and is frozen before validation. No validation or final label, logit, gradient, or target coefficient enters a fit objective.
causal_objective.confirmatory_metric: Selection and final confirmation use direct no-grad suffix response and token-weighted teacher KL ratios, not the adjoint surrogate.

causal_direction_audit.background: selected/frozen state-complete g0 upstream and deployed MLP2
causal_direction_audit.measurement: For each of 64 basis directions, score the loss of omitting that direction from the full projected MLP1 oracle correction, using paired row CE and no final rows.
causal_direction_audit.error_measurement: On the identical live validation states, record each candidate predictor's coefficient error variance per direction.
causal_direction_audit.registered_prediction: Spearman correlation between conditional omission loss per unit target coefficient energy and v1-style affine error variance is positive at MLP1.
causal_direction_audit.weight_rule: w_j is max(abs(conditional omission loss_j)/max(target coefficient second moment_j,1e-12), the preregistered 5th-percentile positive floor), normalized to mean one and frozen in a strata/causal-weight receipt before final.
causal_direction_audit.interpretation: The audit diagnoses the loss metric; it is not a final causal claim and cannot itself add recovery credit.

A_v1_like_z_only_affine_euclidean.fit_target: c_l(z,mo)=p_l(z)-mo B_l, regressed from z alone
A_v1_like_z_only_affine_euclidean.runtime: c_hat_l(z); live mo is deliberately omitted
A_v1_like_z_only_affine_euclidean.purpose: Fresh descriptive negative-anchor cell. B-A isolates the missing live-mo state interface; A is never eligible to be the selected compiler.

B_state_complete_affine_euclidean.purpose: Correct only the state interface while retaining the affine grammar and Euclidean objective.

C_state_complete_affine_causal.fit_loss: The preregistered empirical-Fisher causal objective with isotropic floor 0.05.
C_state_complete_affine_causal.purpose: C-B isolates the fitting objective within the affine grammar.

D_state_complete_native_euclidean.fit: Optimize 4608 scalar term gates under Euclidean projected-output MSE along a frozen L1 path, choose a support of size K, then refit scalar amplitudes on that fixed support. Absorb amplitudes into serialized Q_i.
D_state_complete_native_euclidean.purpose: D-B isolates native bilinear grammar under the Euclidean objective.

E_state_complete_native_causal.fit: Use the identical gate/support/refit solver as D under the preregistered empirical-Fisher causal objective; absorb amplitudes into serialized Q_i.
E_state_complete_native_causal.purpose: E-D isolates objective within native grammar; E-C isolates grammar under the causal objective.

full_native_ceiling_control.fit: Unit amplitudes and exact beta=B^T b; no fitting.
full_native_ceiling_control.purpose: Fail-closed exact executable adequacy identity and causal ceiling. It is a control, not a selectable program and is never reported as compressed.

candidate_families.causal_ablation_contrasts: B-A isolates missing live state; average((C-B),(E-D)) isolates objective; average((D-B),(E-C)) isolates grammar; E-D-C+B is the descriptive interaction.
candidate_families.deferred: Learned paired/CP products are deferred until v2 separates state and loss. They are licensed next only if full-native passes and every K<=256 native candidate fails.

sequential_selection.site0: Fit/build every A-E candidate on compiler_fit baseline states. Score candidate MLP0 alone by direct suffix response on compiler_validation with deployed MLP1/2. Freeze the B-E candidate of smallest standalone price within 1% of the best positive validation teacher-KL recovery R0, subject to no copy worsening above 0.01. A and full-native are controls and cannot win. If no B-E candidate has positive recovery, stop with a clean selection failure; do not substitute full-native.
sequential_selection.site1: Actually deploy frozen Q0 while regenerating compiler_fit/validation MLP1 states. Original MLP0 is poisoned. Fit/build every A-E MLP1 candidate on identical Q0 states. Freeze the B-E candidate of smallest standalone price within 1% of the best positive validation teacher-KL recovery R1, subject to no copy worsening above 0.01. A and full-native are controls and cannot win. If none is positive, stop with a clean selection failure.
sequential_selection.teacher_kl_ratios: R0=KL(OON||QON)/KL(OON||NON); R1=KL(QON||QQN)/KL(QON||QNN); Rjoint=KL(OON||QQN)/KL(OON||NNN). All denominators must be positive. Lower is better and ratios are recomputed directly from frozen teacher/student logits.
sequential_selection.tie_break: Fewer standalone bits, then fewer Hadamard products, then family order B,C,D,E, then smaller rank/K, then larger lambda.
sequential_selection.final_rule: The selected g0/g1 pair, all program tensors, causal weights, token strata, prices, and receipts are frozen atomically before any compiler_final forward. Final is scored once with no fallback or tuning.

controls.old_v1_anchor: The frozen v1 z-only affine program may be rescored descriptively on validation only; it is never a selection winner or final arm.
controls.mean: Train mean of p_l(z), converted at runtime by subtracting live mo B_l.
controls.shuffle: Permute compiler_fit p labels only by equal-size document blocks. Validation targets remain unpermuted; hash the train permutation. Apply the identical family/rank/lambda selection rule.
controls.oracle: Live projected O is a causal ceiling only.

final_evaluation.causal_separation_bank: Freeze one validation representative per A-E cell and score QNN,NQN,QQN for each on compiler_final against one shared NNN. This bank identifies mechanism; no final result changes the representatives.
final_evaluation.lattice: For the validation-selected B-E program only, score the complete {N,Q,O}x{N,Q,O}x{N,E} 18-arm lattice plus state-complete mean and literal shuffle controls at MLP2=N.
final_evaluation.poison: Every N/Q site must make zero original MLP0/1 calls. Only O sites and E at MLP2 may call the corresponding original module.
final_evaluation.statistics: Paired row-weighted source-document cluster bootstrap, 2000 shared draws. Recompute maxima, ratios, and nonlinear margins within every draw.
final_evaluation.paired_mechanism_contrasts: In one shared document-cluster bootstrap, compute Delta_state=gain(B)-gain(A), Delta_objective=((gain(C)-gain(B))+(gain(E)-gain(D)))/2, Delta_grammar=((gain(D)-gain(B))+(gain(E)-gain(C)))/2, and descriptive interaction gain(E)-gain(D)-gain(C)+gain(B), using QQN gains. Apply Holm-adjusted 95% inference to the first three. A positive selected winner alone does not identify a mechanism.
primary_gates: Final direct-response R0,R1,Rjoint are each <=0.50 with positive oracle KL denominators; <=0.25 is reported as the stronger admission rung.
QNN-NNN>0, QQN-QNN>0, and QQN-max(QNN,NQN)>0 each have positive points and 95% lower bounds.
(QQN-NNN)-0.5*(OON-NNN)>0 with positive OON-NNN and positive 95% lower bound.
All four O-neighbor reuse effects have positive points and 95% lower bounds for a modular-site claim; otherwise only an ordered Q0-to-Q1 package claim is eligible.
QQN beats mean and literal shuffle controls with positive lower bounds.
QQE-NNE>0 with positive 95% lower bound; copy collateral worsening is <=0.01 and validation-frozen novel-frequency collateral worsening is <=0.01.
final_evaluation.mlp2_diagnostic: Report QQE-QQN but do not make it conjunctive.

gauge_and_integrity.output_gauge: Use a fixed signed-diagonal orthogonal gauge. After float32 serialization require max absolute physical-correction drift <=2e-6 and max absolute row-CE drift <=2e-6; store both observed drifts and never label this bit-identical.
gauge_and_integrity.native_reciprocal_gauge: Require balanced canonical L/R rows and invariant program output/price under a pre-serialization reciprocal rescaling canary.
integrity_subgates: all pins and protected snapshots unchanged
HEAD equals origin/main before label capture
complete committed clean source closure including authoritative runner tests
program artifact excludes tokens,row indices,labels,cached activations,and checkpoint pointers
hook identity restored and global correction state inert
signed-gauge replay within both preregistered 2e-6 tolerances
gauge_and_integrity.aggregation: Store every subgate separately and set integrity=all(integrity_subgates.values()). Any integrity failure writes a nonauthoritative failure record; statistical failure with integrity true remains authoritative.

pricing_and_reports.native_standalone_reals_per_site: 1152*64 basis + K*(2*1152+64) + 64 beta, plus serialized indices and metadata.
pricing_and_reports.native_amortized_reals_per_site: Omit the basis only under the explicit admitted-basis-library assumption.
pricing_and_reports.K32_price_note: Ignoring tiny metadata, K=32 costs 149,568 reals including basis, approximately price-matched to v1 rank-64 affine at 153,920. Full K=4608 is about 69% of the 15,926,400-real original MLP and is only an adequacy control.
pricing_and_reports.runtime_note: Native runtime multiplies are 147456+2368*K plus K Hadamard products when B^T mo and B reconstruction are charged. Corrected affine rank64 costs 225280 multiplies/site; the live-state correction must not be omitted from runtime price.
required: serialized int8 or explicit no-quantization status

authority_lifecycle: Commit/push prereg before row harvest; commit/push row and validation-receipt sources before labels; freeze rows, strata, causal weights, and programs before final; write nonauthorizing result and manifest with pending hashes; revalidate all pins/protected paths; write authority last. Never overwrite any v1 or v2 artifact; retry requires a new namespace.
